# SlayFit

> SlayFit is a collection of free, no-download games you play with your webcam — your body is the controller. It includes an AR football goalkeeper game, a webcam boxing brawler, and a run-in-place endless runner, all instant in the browser.

SlayFit runs entirely in the web browser: there is nothing to install and no app store. Each game uses real-time webcam pose tracking, so your real movement drives the action. Every game is free and works on the device you already have. A demo mode is available when no camera is present. Site: https://slayfit.fun

## Games

- [Keeper — AR football game](https://slayfit.fun/keeper): A free, no-download AR football game. You are the webcam goalkeeper — your body is scaled to fill the goal, and you dive and lean to save shots that get faster, swervier and wider every level. Play the AR football game today.
- [Monster Punch — free online punch game](https://slayfit.fun/brawler): A free online punch game / webcam boxing brawler in the spirit of classic punch-out games. Throw real punches at incoming monsters, raise both arms to block, and dodge ground traps for a timed cardio round — a no-download, punch-out-style boxing game you play online with your body.
- [Dino Survival — T-Rex run](https://slayfit.fun/dino-survival): A free T-Rex run (trex run) endless runner. Jog on the spot to outrun the beast and reach the jeep, jumping and ducking obstacles with real movement — a full-body, no-download take on the classic T-Rex run game.
